thematic_sectoral_liquidation.rationale: Thematic/sectoral classification alone is not a redemption instruction. Evaluate existing exposure, mandate, benchmark-relative evidence, valuation, overlap, tax lots and exit load. Do not force liquidation or automatically redirect proceeds; new SIP eligibility is assessed separately.

comparison_basis.hard_prohibition: Never score, rank or report a fund against its CATEGORY AVERAGE or peer median.
comparison_basis.why: Category averages include persistently poor funds and are a low bar. A fund can rank top-quartile while destroying value against its own TRI benchmark.
comparison_basis.benchmark_must_be: a Total Return Index, i.e. dividend-reinvested
comparison_basis.reporting_rule: Publish benchmark DELTA at every required horizon. A fund that trails on both 3y and 5y has no stated reason to be held.

rolling_return_rule.why: Trailing returns are path dependent and flattering. A fund that fell 40% and rebounded 90% looks excellent on a trailing window. Rolling windows expose the actual hit rate.
rolling_return_rule.note: Rolling windows are NOT published on a SEBI factsheet. If absent from the dataset, mark the field MISSING. Never substitute trailing returns for rolling returns.

reject_rules.rationale: Underperforming its own TRI benchmark at both medium and long horizon means paying an expense ratio for negative alpha.
Risk-adjusted underperformance: the manager is subtracting value.
High volatility that is not rewarded. Combine with high standard deviation to form the classic exit signature: high SD + low Sharpe + negative alpha.
Excessive churn in a non-momentum strategy destroys value through costs and signals style drift.
The worst combination (RULE-M6): the fund captures less upside in bull markets and more downside in bear markets compared to the benchmark. Exit immediately.

Fund riskometer rating exceeds SEBI statutory maximum ceiling of 6 (Very High). Client portfolio risk capacity is enforced at the strategic allocation level in engine/compliance.py::evaluate_suitability per SEBI IA Reg 16-17 (GAP-097 / TRAP-04).

flag_rules.rationale: High downside capture ratio (RULE-M6). The fund falls harder than the market during crashes. Put on automatic probation.
A fund with <50% benchmark beat rate on rolling 3Y basis is a closet indexer (RULE-M5).
At or above 40% top-10 overlap the second fund is adding tracking noise, not diversification (Requirement.md 4.1 parameter 16 and 4.2 A2b Tier 3 - the only decision-rule tier).
flag_rules.authority: Requirement.md 4.1 parameter 16 and A2b: a pair at or above 40% top-10 overlap is a structural breach.

flag_rules.rationale: A sector above 35% must be an intentional, stated decision. Diversified equity funds (Flexi/Multi/Large Cap) are exempt as broad market exposure to Financial Services (~30% of Nifty 50) is standard.
Manager tenure under 2 years warrants review. Historical returns may belong to predecessor; evaluate process continuity and team depth before any action.

Very large AUM in a mid or small cap fund mechanically dilutes capacity and degrades future alpha. FLAG only - monitor for capacity degradation; do not auto-exit. Large-cap, flexi-cap and proven mid-cap funds with deep process (e.g., HDFC, Motilal, Parag Parikh) often sustain alpha at scale. Updated ceilings per adviser policy section 3.1 parameter 6.
flag_rules.authority: Revised 2026-11-09: Flexi Cap ceiling raised to 180,000 Cr to accommodate PPFAS; Mid Cap ceiling raised to 120,000 Cr to accommodate HDFC Mid-Cap. These thresholds allow proven alpha-generators to scale while maintaining fiduciary oversight.

flag_rules.rationale: Cheaper substitutes exist in the same category. A broad-market index fund runs at roughly 0.10-0.20%.
ILLIQUIDITY RISK (RULE-M4): The fund takes more than 15 days to liquidate 50% of its portfolio based on the AMFI Stress Test.
Micro-cap and illiquid mid-cap sleeves carry liquidity and governance risk that trailing return tables hide.
The fund manager is charging an active fee (TER > 0.5%) but practically hugging the index (Tracking Error < 1.0%). Buy the actual index fund instead for a fraction of the cost.
The Information Ratio is negative, meaning the fund manager is taking active risk but failing to generate active return above the benchmark. The index is superior.

A Yield to Maturity (YTM) significantly higher than the risk-free rate suggests the manager is buying lower-rated, high-risk paper to boost returns. This violates the core safety mandate of a debt fund.

If a small or mid cap fund requires more than 15 days to liquidate 50% of its portfolio, it is carrying severe illiquidity risk. In a market panic, the fund may be forced to gate redemptions or fire-sale quality assets.

A peak-to-trough decline worse than 35% breaches the Large/Multi/Flexi limit. The value is a POSITIVE magnitude, so the test is an upper-bound check; a negative drawdown would satisfy 'x < 35' and silently disable this gate, which is exactly the defect that was found.
Mid and Small caps carry a 55% limit. Positive magnitude, upper-bound test.
Balanced and thematic schemes carry a 45% limit.
Weak downside-adjusted return: the manager fails to generate adequate compensation for downside drawdowns.
Negative Sortino combined with negative alpha indicates pure uncompensated downside wealth destruction.
Fund required more than 1.5 years (378 trading days) to recover from historical peak-to-trough drawdown (RULE-M4).

Fund riskometer rating exceeds default ceiling (Moderately High). Client-specific risk ceilings are enforced separately in the SEBI suitability evaluation (engine/compliance.py::evaluate_suitability).
Fund AUM is below institutional threshold (₹50 Cr for retail diversified equity / ₹5 Cr statutory VR cut-off). High risk of expense bleed, illiquidity, and scheme wind-up.
Value Research eligibility gate: equity schemes must have a minimum 3-year track record across full market cycles before fiduciary recommendation.
Sub-scale holding (< 1.0% of portfolio): generates tax tracking friction without meaningful risk/return contribution. Recommend consolidating into core anchor.
flag_rules.authority: Scripbox Quarterly Portfolio Scan & Decluttering Architecture

flag_rules.rationale: Fund failed to maintain Top-2 quartile ranking in at least 3 of the last 4 calendar years. Multi-cycle consistency not established.
flag_rules.authority: Scripbox Science of Best Mutual Fund Selection

flag_rules.rationale: A Yield to Maturity (YTM) significantly higher than the risk-free rate suggests the manager is buying lower-rated, high-risk paper to boost returns. This violates the core safety mandate of a debt fund.

If a small or mid cap fund requires more than 15 days to liquidate 50% of its portfolio, it is carrying severe illiquidity risk. In a market panic, the fund may be forced to gate redemptions or fire-sale quality assets.

Per CRISIL CMFR and SEBI guidelines, debt funds should maintain at least 80% allocation to Sovereign/AAA rated instruments. Lower credit quality increases default risk and violates the safety mandate of debt funds.

flag_rules.test: modified_duration > 3 AND category NOT IN ('Gilt', 'Gilt 10Y Constant Duration')
flag_rules.rationale: Per CRISIL CMFR, modified duration above 3 years in non-gilt funds indicates excessive interest rate risk. Funds should maintain duration consistent with their stated category mandate.

portfolio_level_rules.rule: equity allocation must sit inside the client risk band; a breach is a discussion trigger, not an automatic trade.

portfolio_level_rules.rationale: Thematic and sector funds limit diversification and are cyclical. They are satellites, never core holdings.
Broad diversified funds should dominate the equity core.

thematic_sectoral_liquidation.rationale: Thematic/Sectoral funds are not core holdings. Evaluate existing exposure, mandate, benchmark-relative evidence, valuation, overlap, tax lots and exit load. Do not force liquidation or automatically redirect proceeds; new SIP eligibility is assessed separately.

data_sufficiency.if_missing: Mark MISSING and state what cannot be concluded. Do not substitute a proxy, do not infer, do not silently drop the test.
prohibited: asserting a fund beats its benchmark when benchmark identity is unknown
ranking funds using only trailing returns
reporting overlap from category labels instead of actual holdings

_added_2026_10_05: Parameter 1 (max drawdown) was specified in the 18-parameter table but NO rule tested it, and the value was negative, so any ceiling test written as '< 35' would have passed. Rules added as upper-bound checks on a positive magnitude.
_overlap_graduated_framework_note: Requirement.md 4.2 A2b: three tiers, ONE decision rule. Tier 1 (>20% pairwise top-10 overlap) is an early-warning flag for monitoring only. Tier 2 (>25% portfolio-weighted common-stock exposure) is a concentration warning only. Tier 3 (>=40% pairwise top-10 overlap, _overlap_threshold_pct) is the ONLY tier that may drive SELL/REPLACE/exit. No fund may be exited on a 20-39% reading.

category_taxonomy._note: SEBI categories and prefixes for classification. All taxonomy classification is policy-driven.
category_taxonomy.match: prefix, case-insensitive, on the category string before any colon

derivation_assumptions._note: Assumptions used when deriving risk metrics from a NAV series. They are POLICY and belong here, not in Python. Every derived figure must state the values used.
derivation_assumptions.risk_free_basis: assumed; must be replaced with a sourced rate before any figure derived from it is quoted to a client

placeholder_detection._note: Market-standard anomaly rule: if a screening metric has identical values across >= 5 unrelated funds (different AMCs), flag as PROVISIONAL / possible placeholder. Requires independent verification before use in gating decisions. Aligned with Morningstar data-quality and Kuvera/ET Money anomaly checks.
placeholder_detection.consequence: Metric is excluded from gating. Fund receives INCONCLUSIVE for that pillar. Human verification required before the metric can be used in a BUY/SELL decision.
placeholder_detection.example: If rolling_3y_beat_rate == 65.0 for 8+ funds from 6+ different AMCs, this is statistically implausible. Flag all as PROVISIONAL. Do NOT use 65% as a passing or failing value until independently sourced.

no_qualifying_candidate_fallback._note: Market-standard fallback: when zero candidates pass all mandatory screens, do NOT silently relax thresholds. Aligned with SEBI IA Regulations 2013 Reg 17 (Suitability) and CFA Standard V(A) (Diligence).
steps: 1. Flag NO_QUALIFYING_CANDIDATE in the manifest with explicit failure reasons per fund.
2. Do NOT silently relax any RESEARCH_HEURISTIC threshold.
3. If the failing metric is RESEARCH_HEURISTIC (e.g. rolling beat rate), the engine MAY recommend the highest-scoring available fund with explicit [PROVISIONAL] badge and documented rationale.
4. If the failing metric is STATUTORY or OPERATIONAL_CONTROL, the engine MUST NOT recommend. Issue BLOCKED.
5. Log the relaxation (if any) as an ADVISER_OVERRIDE with mandatory written justification.
6. Expand the candidate universe (min 30 funds) before concluding no candidate qualifies.
no_qualifying_candidate_fallback.prohibited: Never fabricate or interpolate missing metrics to make a fund appear to pass.

override_governance._note: Market-standard override rules aligned with SEBI IA Regulations, CFA fiduciary duty, and robo-adviser best practices (Kuvera, Groww, ET Money compliance frameworks).

rules.note: Legal obligations (SEBI, CBDT, ITA) can NEVER be overridden by adviser or client.
System integrity gates (data validation, hash checks, state machine) can NEVER be overridden.

rules.requires: Joint client + adviser written sign-off with documented rationale
rules.audit: Must be recorded in ApprovalRecord with timestamp, reason, and expiry

rules.requires: Signed adviser authorization with documented rationale
rules.audit: Must be recorded in manifest evidence block with override_reason
rules.note: Heuristic overrides expire after 90 days and must be re-justified at next review.

prohibited_overrides: Cannot override to bypass a STATUTORY block
Cannot override to mark an unverified action as AUTHORISED
Cannot override to suppress mandatory risk warnings

xirr_edge_cases._note: Boundary conditions for FM-XIRR-V1. Per FINANCIAL_MATH_MODELS.md FM-XIRR-V1 and DEF-016.

amc_concentration._note: AMC-level concentration cap. Per POL-AMC-001 (DEF-015). Cap values UNCONFIGURED until investor approves.

factor_diversification._note: Pairwise correlation and style concentration. Per POL-FACTOR-001 (DEF-012). Requires 36-month NAV series.

withdrawal_policy._note: SWP and withdrawal rules. Per POL-SWP-001 (DEF-009). Cap values UNCONFIGURED until investor approves.
withdrawal_policy.note: 4% withdrawal rule with 6-month liquidity reserve. Tax-optimized lot selection (lowest realized gain first) to minimize capital gains impact. Per POL-SWP-001.

review_policy._note: Review cadence and triggers. Per POL-REVIEW-001 (DEF-010/017).
review_policy.note: Per POL-REVIEW-001. Overdue -> REVIEW_OVERDUE flag, SIP to liquid until acknowledged. Stale data -> REVIEW_BLOCKED_STALE_DATA.

glide_path_policy._note: De-risking glide path for approaching goals. Per POL-GLIDE-001 (DEF-011). Default DISABLED until investor opts in.
glide_path_policy.note: Default DISABLED until investor opts in. Per POL-GLIDE-001. Each de-risking step requires investor + adviser sign-off. No taxable event without tax review. If declined -> GLIDE_PATH_DECLINED documented.

international_gold_policy._note: International equity and gold allocation. Per POL-GEO-001 (DEF-013).
international_gold_policy.note: For VERY_HIGH: international 10% (US feeder), gold 5% (SGB/ETF) per market-standard tolerance. FX disclosure mandatory. Per POL-GEO-001.

goal_achievement_policy._note: Goal achievement and de-risking. Per POL-GOAL-001 (DEF-018).
goal_achievement_policy.note: Per POL-GOAL-001. At target: stop SIP, shift 80% to debt/liquid, retain 20% equity. Freed SIP -> next priority goal. Shortfall/surplus flags at 12 months out.

drawdown_response_protocol._note: Drawdown response protocol. Per POL-DRAWDOWN-001 (DEF-019). Default DISABLED until investor opts in.
drawdown_response_protocol.note: Per POL-DRAWDOWN-001. Tier 1: log. Tier 2: optional rebalance. Tier 3: mandatory rebalance. Tier 4: emergency review. All actions need pre-signature.
